provenance: Read-only original native PostgreSQL ledger written by official Supabase CLI 2.122.0 db push; never manually repaired or populated. Not the schema-only combined verifier database.
statementChecksumAlgorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 statements joined in recorded array order with a single LF (no trailing LF)
limitations: CLI splits statements; the local anchor has 61 statements, not the isolated hosted anchor's single statement. These representations must not be interchanged.
The checksum concerns recorded SQL statement content, not current data or a claim of hosted catalogue equivalence.
Subsequent candidate migrations were applied only to local test databases; their history was not fabricated into this ledger.
